facts.fact: The FAQ explicitly says 2026/27 tickets are electronic. Street Party and Gardens events have no readmission; Street Party, Gardens and NightAfore list age 12+, with under 16 s holding a full-price ticket and accompanied by an adult over 18.

The organiser lists entry searches, bag/item restrictions, no umbrellas and separate rules for different arenas. Accessible viewing places are limited and access needs should be discussed with the organiser.
facts.location: Readmittance, restricted items and disabled access answers.

notes: Actual 2026/27 FAQ read. Alcohol rules differ by arena and are not presented as interchangeable. Assistance-dog and personal-assistant procedures are not generalised to unrestricted admission.
